# The Renegade, Mage Killean

Once a pillar of an order, now a ghost in his own tower. Calm, courteous, and absolutely certain he was right.

**Appearance**: Ageless, fine robes gone travel-stained, a familiar (raven) that never blinks.

**Roleplay**: Defected from a great council; sells secrets or hides them. Will parley, manipulate, or unleash wards. Believes his betrayal was justified.
**Hook**: Holds a lost spell, knows the order's weakness, offers power for a price.
**Stat-ready**: AC 13, HP 41, Spellbook (fireball, invisibility, hold person), Counterspell, Mage Armor.
